title: New hepatitis surveillance report shows strengthened public health cooperation with EU candidate countries
summary: The report brings together surveillance data on hepatitis A from EU candidate countries.

title: Risk to general population remains very low following fourth imported Ebola case in Europe
summary: A healthcare worker based in the DRC who tested positive for Bundibugyo virus on 29 September is being medically evacuated to the Netherlands to receive specialised care.

title: EU-led assessment to Albania will strengthen cross-sector response to antimicrobial resistance
summary: An EU-led mission of experts to Albania this week will identify priority gaps, define areas for further action and support the strengthening of national responses to antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the country.
